78508.commentary: (AP) kammārabhaṇḍā saṇḍāso, muṭṭhy'ādhikaraṇītthīyaṃ, (APt) kammārānaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kammārabhaṇḍaṃ. saṅgamma ḍaṃsatī'ti saṇḍāso, ṇo, niggahītalopo, saṇḍāso, yen'ādittaloh'ādi gayhate. dvayaṃ adhobhāg'aṭṭhe ayoghane.

78509.commentary: (THa) guṇahīnā'ti sīl'ādiguṇavirahitā dussīlā, alajjino ca. atha vā guṇahīnā'ti vinaya-vāritt'ādi-guṇena hīnā dhammavinaye appakataññuno.

examples.text: guṇahīnā'pi saṅghamhi, voharantā visāradā, balavanto bhavissanti, mukharā assutāvino.

78512.commentary: (SNPa) jātitthaddho nāma yo ahaṃ jātisampanno'ti mānaṃ janetvā tena thaddho vātapūritabhastā viya uddhumāto hutvā na kassaci onamati. esa nayo dhanagottatthaddhesu.

examples.text: jātitthaddho dhanatthaddho, gottatthaddho ca yo naro, saññātiṃ atimaññeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
tena hi bhagavato upaṭṭhāko ariyasāvako attano pitā mārito, devadatto ca tam'eva nissāya bhagavato bahuṃ anattham'akāsi, iti mah'āparādho esa, tāya mah'āparādhatāya sayaṃ gantuṃ na sakkoti.

78514.meaning1: full of good qualities; filled with virtues

78517.meaning1: (gram) elision of the middle word in a compound; dropping the word between

examples.text: upādānakkhandhā'ti upādānagocarā khandhā, majjhapadalopo daṭṭhabbo. upādānasambhūtā vā khandhā upādānakkhandhā yathā tiṇ'aggi thus'aggi.

78519.meaning1: cost of a robe; money for cloth; cash for a robe

78520.meaning1: lacking in ethics; deficient in virtue

78521.meaning1: food for a traveller; meal for someone going on a journey
78521.commentary: (VSa) gamikabhattepi ayam'eva kathāmaggo. ayaṃ pana viseso, āgantuko āgantukabhattam'eva labhati, gamiko āgantukabhattam'pi gamikabhattam'pi. āvāsiko'pi pakkamitu'kāmo gamiko hoti, gamikabhattaṃ labhati.

examples.text: so me gamikabhattaṃ bhuñjitvā satthā na vihāyissati, yattha vāsaṃ gantu'kāmo bhavissati tattha kāle upagacchissati, akilanto addhānaṃ gamissati. im'āhaṃ, bhante, atthavasaṃ sampassamānā icchāmi saṅghassa yāvajīvaṃ gamikabhattaṃ dātuṃ.
es'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañ'ca, bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca. upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇagatan'ti.

78524.meaning1: rice for making gruel; rice for preparing congee

examples.text: sāmi, nakkhattaṃ nāma sadhanānaṃ hoti, mama pana gehe svātanāya yāgutaṇḍulam'pi n'atthi, kiṃ me nakkhattena, goṇe labhanto kasituṃ gamissāmī'ti.

78526.meaning1: all ways; all details; every aspect

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabb'ākārasampanno, tatr'idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā. tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya

tato pāsādikaṃ āsi, gataṃ bhuttaṃ nisevitaṃ, siniddhā teladhārā'va, ahosi iriyāpatho.

78551.meaning1: with a foot; having (a certain type of) feet; -footed

78553.meaning1: having given preference (to); having given weight (to); having gone by; having based one's argument (on)

te na sakkoma ñāpetuṃ aññam'aññaṃ mayaṃ ubho, bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamā, sambuddhaṃ iti vissutaṃ.

78555.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in quick realization; Bhaddā Kuṇḍalakesā
78555.commentary: (ANa) khipp'ābhiññānan'ti khipp'ābhiññānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ, bhaddā kuṇḍalakesā, aggā'ti dasseti. ayam'pi hi padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattā satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ khipp'ābhiññānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā kassapabuddhakāle kikissa kāsirañño gehe sattannaṃ bhaginīnaṃ abbhantarā hutvā vīsati vassasahassāni dasa sīlāni samādāya komārikabrahmacariyaṃ carantī saṅghassa vasanapariveṇaṃ kāretvā ekaṃ buddhantaraṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde rājagahanagare seṭṭhikule paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhi, bhaddā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ akaṃsu. (THIa) bhaddā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā mahatā parivārena vaḍḍhamānā vayappattā, tasmiṃ'y'eva nagare purohitassa puttaṃ sattukaṃ nāma coraṃ sahoḍḍhaṃ gahetvā rāj'āṇāya nagaraguttikena māretuṃ āghātanaṃ niyyamānaṃ, sīhapañjarena olokentī disvā paṭibaddhacittā hutvā sace taṃ labhāmi, jīvissāmi, no ce, marissāmī'ti sayane adhomukhī nipajji.
78555.notes: Therīgāthā verses 107-111 (TH5.9, TH46) are attributed to her.

examples.text: puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ, sappañño vat'āyaṃ upāsako, yo bhaddāya cīvaraṃ adāsi, vippamuttāya sabbaganthehī'ti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ khipp'ābhiññānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddā kuṇḍalakesā.

78556.commentary: (DNa) khantī paramaṃ tapo'ti adhivāsanakhanti nāma paramaṃ tapo. titikkhā'ti khantiyā eva vevacanaṃ. titikkhā saṅkhātā adhivāsanakhanti uttamaṃ tapo'ti attho.

examples.text: khantī paramaṃ tapo tītikkhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā, na hi pabbajito par'ūpaghātī, na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.

examples.text: āsandipañcamā purisā mataṃ ādāya gacchanti, yāv'āḷāhanā padāni paññāyanti. kāpotakāni aṭṭhīni bhavanti.

78558.meaning1: causes to stick; causes to cling; makes adhere; makes attached (to)

78561.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ sattahi dvārehi asucivamanaṃ dassetvā kālaññū puggalaññū parisaññū ca bhagavā taduttari dve dvārāni visesavacanena anāmasitvā aparena pariyāyena sabbasmā'pi kāyā asucisavanaṃ dassento āha kāyamhā sedajallikā'ti. sedajallikā'ti sedo ca loṇapaṭalamalabhedā jallikā ca, tassa savati sabbadā'ti iminā saddhiṃ sambandho.

examples.text: siṅghāṇikā ca nāsato, mukhena vamat'ekadā, pittaṃ semhañ'ca vamati, kāyamhā sedajallikā.
assa indasamo rāja, accantaṃ ajar'āmaro, sace tvaṃ yaññaṃ yājeyya, isiṃ lomasakassapaṃ.

78563.commentary: (THIa) paṭhamavasanto sukho utū'ti ayaṃ paṭhamo vasantamāso sukhasamphasso ca utu vattatī'ti attho.

examples.text: madhurañ'ca pavanti sabbaso, kusumarajena samuṭṭhitā dumā, paṭhamavasanto sukho utu, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.
so ārāmagataṃ bhikkhuṃ passeyya sudhotahatthapādaṃ manuññaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ sītāya chāyāya nisinnaṃ adhicitte yuttaṃ. tassa evam'assa, sukhaṃ vata, bho, sāmaññaṃ, ārogyaṃ vata, bho, sāmaññaṃ!

examples.text: [apa. therī 2.4.157 apadāne'pi] āturaṃ asuciṃ pūtiṃ, passa nande samussayaṃ, asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi, ek'aggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.

sadā jāgaramānānaṃ, ahoratt'ānusikkhinaṃ, nibbānaṃ adhimuttānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.

78588.commentary: (MNa) ādibrahmacariyan'ti brahmacariyassa ādibhūtā uppādakā janakā'ti evaṃ paṭijānantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: santi pana, bhāradvāja, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena diṭṭhadhamm'ābhiññā-vosāna-pāramippattā, ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti, seyyathā'pi takkī vīmaṃsī.

78589.meaning2: living on what is given by others
78589.meaningLit: living on what is given by others
78589.commentary: (SNPa) paradatt'ūpajīvī'ti pabbajito. so hi udakadantapoṇaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ paren'eva dattaṃ upajīvati, tasmā paradatt'ūpajīvī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yadaggato majjhato sesato vā, piṇḍaṃ labhetha paradatt'ūpajīvī, n'ālaṃ thutuṃ no'pi nipaccavādī, taṃ vā'pi dhīrā muni vedayanti.

78590.meaning1: having this purpose; with this goal
78590.commentary: (MNa) ayam'attho etassā'ti etadatthaṃ, arahattaphal'attham'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. ayaṃ etassa attho'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yā ca kho ayaṃ, bhikkhave, akuppā cetovimutti, etadattham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan'ti.

78592.meaning1: with theories; speculating about; with opinions
78592.commentary: (MNa) tesaṃ evaṃ apar'antaṃ kappetvā ṭhitānaṃ punappunaṃ uppajjanavasena apar'antam'eva anugatā diṭṭhī'ti apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino. te evaṃdiṭṭhino taṃ apar'antaṃ ārabbha āgamma paṭicca aññam'pi janaṃ diṭṭhigatikaṃ karontā anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti.

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā apar'antakappikā apar'anta-anudiṭṭhino apar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhivuttipadāni abhivadanti.

78594.meaning1: name of a hall in Pāṭaliputta

examples.text: atha kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo etissā ca niccabhikkhāya aparāya ca niccabhikkhāya pāṭaliputte saṅghassa upaṭṭhānasālaṃ kārāpesi. sā eta'r'ahi ghoṭamukhī'ti vuccatī'ti.

78595.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābhucca
78595.meaning1: as it really is; according to the true nature of things
78595.construction:
yathā + bhūta + ya + aṃ
yathābhucca + aṃ

examples.text: nakkhattāni namassantā, aggiṃ paricaraṃ vane, yathābhuccam'ajānantā, bālā suddhim'amaññatha.

78597.meaning1: transcending; overcoming; going beyond; crossing over

examples.text: ahañ'hi, mārisa, niccaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ niccan'ti vadāmi, dhuvaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ dhuvan'ti vadāmi, sassataṃ'y'eva samānaṃ sassatan'ti vadāmi, kevalaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ kevalan'ti vadāmi, acavanadhammaṃ'y'eva samānaṃ acavanadhamman'ti vadāmi

78599.commentary: (MNa) sabbamaññitānan'ti sabbesaṃ tiṇṇam'pi taṇhā-diṭṭhi-māna-maññitānaṃ. mathitānan'ti tesaṃ'y'eva vevacanaṃ. (MNt) yattha uppajjanti, taṃ sattaṃ mathenti sammaddantī'ti mathitā'ti āha mathitānan'ti tesaṃ'y'eva vevacanan'ti.

examples.text: tasmā tathāgato sabbamaññitānaṃ sabbamathitānaṃ sabba-ahaṃkāra-mamaṃkāra-mān'ānusayānaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā anupādā vimutto'ti vadāmī'ti.
